messages.content: Hello, say Hello in 10 different languages

Sure! Here’s how to say "Hello" in 10 different languages:

1. Spanish: Hola
2. French: Bonjour
3. German: Hallo
4. Italian: Ciao
5. Portuguese: Olá
6. Russian: Здравствуйте (Zdravstvuyte)
7. Chinese (Mandarin): 你好 (Nǐ hǎo)
8. Japanese: こんにちは (Konnichiwa)
9. Arabic: مرحبا (Marhaban)
10. Hindi: नमस्ते (Namaste)

Let me know if you need anything else!
